name: Macr
description:
The complete macOS experience for your Linux desktop.

A macOS menu bar and dock for GNOME. The menu bar has the Apple-style logo menu, the focused app's name and menu, the app's own menus when it shares them, a Window menu, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and battery menus and a macOS clock on a translucent bar. The dock has frosted glass, magnification, app badges, a Downloads stack, the apps you quit last, a Trash, autohide and the genie minimize. Launchpad shows every app on Super, and Spotlight searches apps, files and settings, converts units and currencies, defines words and searches the web with Ctrl+Space. Quick settings become the macOS Control Center, with Focus, app icons your theme lacks get a macOS tile, volume and brightness show as a pill at the top right, Alt+Tab looks like the macOS app switcher, and notifications show at the top right with a macOS Notification Center on the clock that stacks them per app. The overview becomes Mission Control, and hot corners open it, Launchpad, the desktop and more. Stage Manager keeps the app you use in the middle and your other apps on the left, one click away. Windows that do not round their own corners get rounded macOS corners, app windows get the red, yellow and green traffic lights on the left, with the macOS window menu on the green one, and the lock screen shows a big time at the top with your picture and the password field below, as can the login screen. Windows tile to halves, quarters and the full screen when dragged to the screen edges or with Super+Ctrl and the arrow keys. Super+Shift+3, 4 and 5 take screenshots as on a Mac, with a floating thumbnail after each one. Super stands in for Command to quit, minimize and hide apps, Ctrl+Super+Space opens an Emoji & Symbols picker, App Exposé shows all of one app's windows, and full-screen apps get a Space of their own. Space or Super+Y opens Quick Look on a file, Macr takes a macOS accent colour or one from your wallpaper, and the desktop picture can follow the time of day. The appearance can turn dark at night, any folder can sit in the dock as a stack, and clock, calendar, weather, batteries, photo and Now Playing widgets, small, medium or large, can sit on the desktop and be added from a widget gallery.
